key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:07FC
name: compare_cell_then_advance_position
description: Returns 0 when the given value equals a stored lookup entry for the current position; otherwise it adds an offset to a stored position byte and returns 1 only if the new cell is not blocked and its id is absent from the roster.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0812
name: advance_position_if_unblocked
description: Adds an offset to a stored position byte, then returns 1 when the resulting cell is not flagged as blocked and its id is not in the ten-entry roster, and 0 otherwise.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0830
name: test_id_absent_from_roster
description: Scans the ten roster records from the first entry for the stored id, returning 0 on a match and 1 when no record matches.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0834
name: scan_roster_for_id
description: Scans the ten roster records starting from an index held in a register, returning 0 when the stored id is found and 1 when the scan runs past the last record.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0852
name: scan_roster_after_index
description: Steps the roster index forward before each comparison, returning 0 when a record matches the stored id and 1 once the index passes the last record.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0862
name: select_cheapest_free_neighbour
description: Picks the lowest-cost unoccupied candidate among up to ten slots, saving its index and cost into state bytes. When a special terrain code is found on a free slot it returns early, and the fallback branch returns the first character of a text entry converted to uppercase.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0886
name: pick_cheapest_free_slot
description: Scans five slot records, skipping the current slot and any occupied one, and keeps the lowest cost and its index in state bytes. It returns early when a slot carries the special terrain code and the slot is free.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:088C
name: find_cheapest_slot_or_terrain
description: Looks for a free slot carrying a special terrain code across the record list, and otherwise tallies the cheapest remaining cost among the first set of slots, returning that cost.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:08E4
name: find_next_cheapest_slot
description: Walks the slot list upward from the current index, stopping at a free slot with the special terrain code, and otherwise records the cheapest unoccupied slot found in state bytes.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:08EE
name: update_cheapest_slot_from_index
description: Compares the cost of each unoccupied slot from the current index up to a limit with the stored best, and replaces the best cost and slot index when a cheaper one is found.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:093A
name: resolve_unit_step_and_redraw
description: Reads the terrain and cost of the current cell, derives a direction from the comparison, and runs the step-testing routines in sequence. When a valid step is found it writes the chosen tile into the board and calls the redraw and update helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:09AE
name: update_board_cell_after_step
description: Compares the stored cost of the current position with the neighbour's cost, runs the step-test routines, and then writes the selected tile value into the board before calling the update helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:09D0
name: dispatch_cell_update_by_direction
description: Chooses one of several step-test sequences based on the direction value, running the step tests and writing the chosen tile into the board when one succeeds, then calling the update helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0A04
name: run_cell_update_loop
description: Repeats the step-test routines until one of them succeeds, then writes the chosen tile into the board and calls the update helpers. A first-pass flag makes it exit once the loop has run.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0A0C
name: run_masked_cell_update_loop
description: Runs the same step-test and board-write loop as its neighbours, but gates the first pass on a flag bit in the direction byte, then calls the update helpers when it finishes.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0A16
name: retry_cell_update_until_fail
description: Retries the step-test routines in a loop, stopping when any of three tests fails, then writes the chosen tile into the board and calls the update helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0A26
name: forward_to_helper_routine
description: Does nothing but call a single helper routine and return; the decompiled body is a plain forwarding stub with no logic of its own.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0A2E
name: run_two_test_cell_update
description: Runs two step tests in order and, if both pass, runs a further test sequence before writing the chosen tile into the board and calling the update helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0A4E
name: run_triple_test_cell_update
description: Runs three step tests in order and writes the chosen tile into the board when they succeed, then calls the update helpers. A loop flag controls a repeat of the sequence.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0A6E
name: run_triple_test_update_copy
description: Identical in structure to the preceding routine: three step tests, a loop-controlled repeat, then a board write and the update helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0A8E
name: run_triple_test_update_copy2
description: Identical in structure to the triple-test cell update above: three step tests, a loop-controlled repeat, then a board write and the update helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0AAC
name: run_triple_test_update_copy3
description: Same three-test step loop and board write as its neighbours, with the update helpers called on exit.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0AC8
name: run_triple_test_update_copy4
description: Same three-test step loop and board write as its neighbours, with the update helpers called on exit.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0AE4
name: run_triple_test_update_copy5
description: Same three-test step loop and board write as its neighbours, with the update helpers called on exit.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0B00
name: run_multi_test_cell_update
description: Runs a longer sequence of step tests, counting how many succeed in the flag cell, and writes the chosen tile into the board before calling the update helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0B68
name: dispatch_zero_or_read_char
description: Calls a helper with index zero when the stack check passes; otherwise it reads a stored character and converts it to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0B7A
name: dispatch_one_or_read_char
description: Calls a helper with index one when the stack check passes; otherwise it reads a stored character and converts it to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0B8E
name: dispatch_two_or_read_char
description: Calls a helper with index two when the stack check passes; otherwise it reads a stored character and converts it to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0BA2
name: dispatch_three_or_read_char
description: Calls a helper with index three when the stack check passes; otherwise it reads a stored character and converts it to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0BB6
name: dispatch_four_or_read_char
description: Calls a helper with index four when the stack check passes; otherwise it reads a stored character and converts it to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0BCA
name: dispatch_five_or_read_char
description: Calls a helper with index five when the stack check passes; otherwise it reads a stored character and converts it to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0BDE
name: dispatch_six_or_read_char
description: Calls a helper with index six when the stack check passes; otherwise it reads a stored character and converts it to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0BF2
name: dispatch_seven_or_read_char
description: Calls a helper with index seven when the stack check passes; otherwise it reads a stored character and converts it to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0C06
name: place_tile_first_free_neighbour
description: Scans the eight neighbouring directions for a cell whose tile code is compatible, not blocked and absent from the roster, then stores it in the roster, calls the board update helpers and decrements the position counter. If the scan finds nothing it returns the current index.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0C1E
name: place_tile_first_valid_slot
description: Walks candidate slots and, for the first unblocked compatible cell not already in the roster, writes it into the roster, calls the update helpers and decrements a counter. It returns the chosen slot index.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0CB0
name: place_tile_across_candidate_slots
description: Iterates over five candidate slots, testing each neighbour cell for compatibility and roster absence, and on success writes the tile, calls the update helpers and decrements the counter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0D36
name: place_tile_resuming_slot_scan
description: Advances to the next slot when the current neighbour test fails and resumes scanning from there, placing the tile and decrementing the counter once a compatible unblocked cell is found.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0D50
name: forward_to_single_helper_call
description: Does nothing but call one helper routine and return; the decompiled body is a plain forwarding stub with no logic of its own.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0D5C
name: count_free_candidate_cells
description: Counts the free candidate cells within a range of slots and, when the special terrain codes fifteen or minus one are found, marks three flag entries with a sentinel. It returns the count of free cells.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0DA8
name: count_free_candidate_cells_loop
description: Loops over the candidate slots counting those that are free and compatible, marking three flag entries with a sentinel when a special terrain code appears, then returns the count.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0DAE
name: count_candidate_cells_by_direction
description: Loops over nine table entries, counting slots whose offset-adjusted tile matches the target code and that are unoccupied, and records each match. When the special terrain code is set it clears the flags and then returns the adjusted count.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0E76
name: clear_flags_on_minus_one
description: Tests the stored terrain code of a cell against the marker value minus one and, when it matches, sets three directional flag bytes to a sentinel and decrements the counter. It returns the adjusted counter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0ECC
name: run_four_iteration_draw_loop
description: Runs four passes that call a draw helper, a helper with a constant value of 200 and a reset helper on each pass, and returns 4 when the stack check passes. Otherwise it reads a stored character and converts it to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0EEA
name: run_four_draw_loop_unchecked
description: Runs the same four-pass draw loop as its neighbour without the stack check, calling the draw helper, the constant-value helper and the reset helper on each pass.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0F36
name: run_unit_turn_with_messages
description: Resolves one unit turn over up to five slots, computing a cost from a lookup table and terrain code, updating stored position counters and printing message strings for the outcome. Certain terrain codes trigger a random roll of one in a hundred that can change the result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:0FA8
name: resolve_unit_step_costs
description: Continues the turn logic of the preceding routine: it computes per-slot costs from terrain codes, applies a random roll for the special terrain code, updates the position counters and calls the message and draw helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:108E
name: apply_unit_cost_modifiers
description: Continues the unit turn logic by applying a terrain-cost modifier from a table, scaling the cost by flag bits, and updating the position counters. When the unit index is below five it writes the affected slot value back.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:10B4
name: select_terrain_cost_modifier
description: Maps four terrain codes to table indices zero to three, looks up a cost value for the current cell and adds it to the stored cost. Unmatched codes skip the lookup.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:10C2
name: select_terrain_cost_for_codes
description: Looks up the cost modifier for terrain codes eight and nine and for code twenty-two, adding it to the stored cost, and otherwise continues the turn logic.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:10CC
name: select_cost_for_codes_two
description: Handles terrain code nine and code twenty-two with the same table-based cost adjustment, then continues the turn logic.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:10D6
name: select_cost_for_code_22
description: Handles only terrain code twenty-two with the table-based cost adjustment, then continues the turn logic.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1106
name: run_unit_action_message_loop
description: Runs the per-slot loop of a unit turn, subtracting the step value from each slot's counter, printing the action message strings and updating the scoring totals, with a 'retry' branch when the counter goes negative. It is a long routine that calls many helpers.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:128A
name: print_slot_turn_messages
description: Prints the turn message for the current slot, including a space and a unit name string when the unit flag is set, and then updates the slot's counter.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1306
name: print_unit_turn_summary
description: Prints the summary text for a unit's turn, choosing between two message strings depending on the flag bits, then adjusts the slot counters and marks the slot as acted on.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:137C
name: finish_unit_turn_bookkeeping
description: Finishes a unit's turn by writing the chosen board value and updating the slot counters, then calls the draw and message helpers when the move flag is set.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1454
name: finalise_unit_step_state
description: Updates the active unit state after a step: records the new slot, calls the draw and message helpers, and sets the step marker byte when the slot has not yet been visited.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:14B6
name: restore_unit_slot_and_redraw
description: Writes saved slot values back into the unit table, calls the draw helpers for the slot, and when the unit index is below five stores the restored value. It returns after the redraw sequence.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1554
name: print_slot_tally_message
description: Calls a message helper with values taken from a per-slot table, increments the slot's tally byte, and returns the slot index.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:15D8
name: merge_two_unit_slots
description: Takes two slot indices and moves or combines their unit records, clearing the source flags and redrawing the affected slots when the mode allows.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:16BA
name: compact_unit_slot_records
description: Scans the unit slot records and moves each occupied record forward into the first free slot, copying its fields and clearing the old flag until the list is contiguous.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:16E4
name: move_unit_record_free_slot
description: Copies one unit record's fields into a free slot and clears the source record's flag, updating the slot scan variables to continue the compaction.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:181E
name: compact_unit_slot_records_retry
description: Repeats the slot-record compaction scan from the next index, moving occupied records into free slots until the scan reaches the slot limit.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:186A
name: find_slot_index_for_id
description: Scans the first five slot records for the given id and stores the matching slot index as the current slot, stopping at the first match.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:188C
name: find_next_slot_with_id
description: Steps forward through the slot records looking for the given id, storing the current slot index when found and calling a helper when the search ends.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:18A4
name: copy_slot_record_to_index
description: Copies a sixteen-byte unit record from one slot to another, zeroes the destination's status fields and returns the destination index.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1A2A
name: accumulate_slot_counter
description: Adds a value from a helper or from the parameter to the current slot's counter when its record code matches a specific case, stores the counter in the slot table, and returns the slot index.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1AAC
name: invalidate_out_of_range_slots
description: Walks all ten slot records and marks any with a code above twenty-four or an invalid flag as cleared by setting its bytes to the invalid value. It returns 10 when the stack check passes; otherwise it reads a stored text character and uppercases it.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1ABC
name: invalidate_slots_copy
description: Performs the same ten-slot invalidation pass as its neighbour, clearing records whose code exceeds twenty-four or whose flag is invalid, without the stack check.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1AFC
name: clear_slots_matching_code
description: Calls a helper with the table entry for the given code, then clears every slot that holds that code by calling a helper with a zero argument for each match. It returns 10 when the stack check passes.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1B40
name: clear_slots_matching_code_copy
description: Loops over the ten slots and calls a helper with a zero argument for each record holding the given code, without the stack check or the preceding helper call.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1B72
name: test_code_absent_from_slots
description: Returns 0 and reports through a message helper when the code is already held in a slot or flagged in the table, and returns 1 when neither applies. Otherwise it reads a stored text character and uppercases it.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1B86
name: scan_slots_for_matching_code
description: Scans the slot records for the given code or a flagged table entry, returning 1 when no match is found and 0 after a message helper call otherwise.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1BB8
name: scan_remaining_slots_for_code
description: Scans slot records forward from the current index for the given code, returning 1 when the scan runs out and 0 with a message helper call when a match is found.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1BC8
name: assign_slot_code_and_draw
description: Stores the given code into the current slot, draws the slot graphic using values from the table, and then calls a follow-up helper before returning its result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1C4A
name: draw_table_indexed_graphic
description: Draws a graphic entry for the given index by calling a helper with a table pointer and a stored value, then calls two follow-up helpers and returns the result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1CA0
name: draw_unit_stat_panel
description: Draws the stat panel for a unit: it reads the slot's code and attribute values from tables, calls draw helpers with them, adds an extra panel when a flag is set, and finishes with two fixed helper calls.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1D60
name: test_special_code_and_flag
description: Returns 1 when the given code equals the special value twenty-four and otherwise returns 0, calling a helper to set a status flag in the matching case.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1DA0
name: draw_slot_stat_label
description: Calls a draw helper with a label taken from a table indexed by the current slot's code, followed by a second helper call, and returns the result. It reads a stored text character and uppercases it when the stack check fails.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1DA6
name: read_text_char_uppercased
description: Reads a stored text character through a helper and returns it converted to uppercase when it is a lowercase letter. It is a shared stub called from many places.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1DAC
name: forward_args_with_code_19
description: Forwards its four arguments to a helper together with the constant code nineteen, returning that helper's result.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1DB2
name: dispatch_graphics_command
description: Dispatches a graphics command selected by its first argument; command one prepares the draw state from the stack arguments and other command branches draw or update their own objects. Most of the body is a large dispatch structure, so only its overall shape is recovered.

key: king's bounty (1990)(new world computing)[cr skr]/King's Bounty (1990)(New World Computing)[cr SKR].adf:King's Bounty:1:1DB8
name: render_text_char_after_read
description: Reads a value through a helper, passes that result to a second helper, and returns the second helper's result. A stack check failure path reads and uppercases a stored character.
